headline: Tri-County Financial Group Shareholders Approve Merger with HBT Financial
summary: Shareholders of Tri-County Financial Group voted to approve the company's merger with HBT Financial.
why: Bank mergers and acquisitions alter the competitive landscape and geographic footprint of regional financial institutions.

impacts.name: Tri-County Financial Group
impacts.why: Shareholder approval clears a key regulatory and corporate hurdle for finalizing the business combination.
